text:
Elaine (Partnerships): Quick sync — Vervelabs approached us to list Verva-7B on the cloud marketplace and offer an SI bundle with Orchida. They shipped weights under a custom 'Vervelabs Research License (VRL)'. Need to decide redistribution model for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
Raj (Legal): VRL looks mostly research-only, with some enterprise exceptions. Can you paste the license excerpt? put @legal-bot in thread to run a diff vs Apache/CC-BY?
Elaine (Partnerships): pasted snippet from their license: 
```
Section 3. Redistribution: weights may be hosted under commercial contracts with attribution; redistribution to third parties requires express written permission. Non-commercial research allowed.
```
Nina (Product): Key constraint: Dedicated customers expect to be able to download weights for on-prem bundles in some enterprise deals. If VRL forbids redistribution, Dedicated / Private offering might be limited. We need an allowed-to-distribute addendum or a 'download exemption' for reserved-capacity customers.
Marco - Orchida SI: Orchida needs to pre-bundle quantized weights into appliances we ship for customers. We can't rely on one-off written permissions per customer. Would the addendum be a single enterprise redistribution grant?
Raj (Legal): Yes, standard approach is a commercial redistribution addendum limited to named customers or to Redwood+SI distribution. Two options: (A) universal commercial redistribution clause (broad) or (B) per-deal addendum granting Redwood+SI rights for specific customers. A is cleaner but harder to get. I'll draft both.
Ben - EdgeHW: From HW partner POV, we also want to certify the model for our edge runtime (runtime badge). That requires access to quantized weights and test vectors. Can we include a QA-only distribution channel?
Elaine (Partnerships): Good idea — propose a "certification bundle" that permits EdgeHW/Orchida to receive weights for testing/certification only, under NDA, no further redistribution. Separate from customer-facing redistribution.
Nina (Product): Timeline: Vervelabs wants listing + joint announcement within 6 weeks. Product needs ~3 weeks to run perf/latency profiles & compile runtime builds. Marketing needs embargo dates.
Raj (Legal): Drafting note: Include these clauses: 
- Named sublicense to Redwood and its SI partners for packaging & distribution to paying customers (if addendum chosen).
- Certification/NDA channel for hardware vendors.
- Audit & provenance clause: Vervelabs requests signature verifying copy-of-origin; we should offer attestation but not promise escrow.
I'll send a redline by EOD.
Elaine (Partnerships): Marketing ask: Vervelabs wants a co-branded launch page + joint blog. They also want a "no-download" tier for Hosted API only, and a "download+SI" tier for enterprise customers if we secure addendum.
Marco - Orchida SI: If we get per-deal addendum, Orchida will accept per-customer paperwork, but we need a template form. Can someone prepare a one-page SOW + redistribution appendix?
Nina (Product): Action items: 
- Raj to circulate redline for both addendum options (A/B).
- Elaine to negotiate with Vervelabs: ask for enterprise addendum or a certification channel.
- Marco & Ben to share HW QA checklist (quant format, test vectors, expected throughput).
- Product to reserve a slot for perf runs week of 3755600000.
Raj (Legal): I'll include suggested indemnity limits and standard export controls language. Note: if weights contain 3rd-party data we need provenance confirmation. @legal-bot: run license-compare on VRL vs Apache2 & CC-BY to flag conflicts.
legal-bot: license-compare complete: VRL vs Apache2 -> conflict on redistribution clause; VRL is more restrictive. Export-control flags: none obvious; recommend provenance attestation.
Elaine (Partnerships): Sounds good. Nina, can marketing hold 2 alternate embargo dates? A (broad addendum secured): 6 weeks. B (per-deal rollout): staged starting 8–10 weeks.
Nina (Product): Holding dates. Marco — can Orchida accept certification-only delivery in week 4 for runtime integration?
Marco - Orchida SI: Yes, we can accept NDA'd cert bundle wk4. We'll need contact for SRE handoff.
Ben - EdgeHW: I'll prep test vectors and quantization notes: prefer int8 TQ + reference scripts. Dropping them into shared drive now.
Elaine (Partnerships): I'll kick off with Vervelabs: ask for addendum preference, provenance docs, and marketing assets. Will update here after their reply. :thumbsup:
Nina (Product): Thanks — also flagging perf targets for Dedicated: 50ms p99 on 8k context for Verva-7B quantized. If we can't hit that, adjust messaging.
Elaine (Partnerships): Noted. Closing for now — will post Vervelabs' response in this thread.
